title: Cycle 5 Explorer
idiom: a brass decoder ring laid on a drafting sheet, engraved with note names and Roman numerals, hand-pulled screenprint in flat inks; icon as a bold linocut ring of twelve notches with one wedge cut out
hero_prompt: Hand-pulled screenprint on cream drafting paper in four flat inks, slight misregistration, visible paper grain, flat and graphic, hand-made, not a photograph, not a 3D render, no depth-of-field, no gradients: a wide close view of a large round brass decoder ring lying on a sheet of cream engineering paper, three concentric turnable rings, the outer ring engraved with seven mode names in small capitals, the middle ring with the seven letter names F C G D A E B in heavy type, the inner ring with the numerals 1 to 7, and one narrow wedge of the ring hatched with fine diagonal lines. A thumb and forefinger at the right edge are turning the middle ring. Faint hairline rules and a small title block drawn in ink in the lower corner of the sheet. Flat inks only: black, cream, brass amber, a muted rose on one mode name, and one spot of engineering red on the numeral 1.
icon_prompt: Linocut emblem, a flat single-colour black silhouette on a warm amber ground, no shading or gradients: a thick round ring seen straight on with twelve short radial notches cut into its outer edge like a dial, a narrow wedge of the ring missing at the lower left, and a solid small circle at the centre. Nothing else. Bold, high-contrast, no fine linework, reads clearly at 24 pixels.
